title_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek Bulevardi i Ri, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte !
description_sq: Tek Bulevardi i Ri, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 101.2 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 12-te banim te nje Reszidence te re banimi,ne faze karabinaje. Apartamenti organizohet ne ambientin e ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon, dhome gjumi femijesh dhe nje tualet i aksesueshem ne korridor. Zona e Bulevardit te Ri, cilesohet si nje nder zonat me me prespektive ne aspektin e zhvilimit te infrastruktures, sherbimeve dhe aksesit me zonat qendrore te Tiranes, duke e bere te lakmueshme si per investim ne te ardhmen, si dhe per banim.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! At New Boulevard, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Floor Plan!
description_en: At New Boulevard, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Floor Plan!! The apartment with a total area of ​​101.2 m2 is located on the 12th residential floor of a new residential residence, in the construction phase. The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom with access to the balcony, a children's bedroom and a toilet accessible in the corridor. The New Boulevard area is considered one of the most promising areas in terms of infrastructure development, services and access to the central areas of Tirana, making it enviable both for investment in the future and for housing.
